label: No placebo
rationale: This is an open-label, single-arm study with sequential dose cohorts of orelabrutinib only; the described design compares participants to their own pre-treatment run-in rather than to any placebo arm. No inactive or active-placebo comparator is described.

evidence.quote: A Single-Center, Open-Label, Single-Arm, Dose-Escalation Investigator-Initiated Clinical Study
uses a 3+3 dose-escalation design to evaluate oral orelabrutinib in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).
Pretreatment and on-treatment functional trajectories will be compared within participants.
Participants receive orelabrutinib 50 mg orally once daily (QD) for 24 weeks.

title: Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacodynamic Exploration of Orelabrutinib in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
